title: The report guard's model check reads spawns from before a compaction
why: After a compaction, the guard's records hold no spawn from before it, so a Done item that names a pre-compaction reviewer is called wrong whatever its model. Note report-model-before-compact (on #1921): the check fired 4 times in lane session-worktree-strands-agents on reviewers spawned with model sonnet. It may also be the real cause of the no-model-field sightings on step report-guard-role-default-model (lane report-guard-role-default-model, 05:23 CST Nov 8).
note: Fix: the guard reads spawn records from before the compaction (the full transcript or the handoff's agent list), or says "unknown" instead of "wrong" for a name it cannot match; red case first on a Done item naming a reviewer spawned before a compaction. Not covered by #1919. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Filed 05:25 CST Nov 8 (the coordinator's name for it: report-model-before-compact). Doing in lane report-guard-role-default-model as a follow-up PR from #1919's head (coordinator and lane, 05:22 CST Nov 8). Measured (lane, 05:33 CST Nov 8): the cause is not compaction. Main's guard compares a named model only against spawns since the last report; #1705 compares against the whole transcript, which keeps pre-compaction records. 4 of the 7 refusals in session_013NEJL3bvXbg7UQvaKpwwq9 are that case; 3 are true refusals (role named with no model). The lane proposed closing this step as covered by #1705, plus an optional pinning test; the coordinator's pick is pending. Sighting 05:47 CST Nov 8: lane notes-fix-large-1 (session_013NEJL4DPEKRiC91yHkQV7m) was refused "reviewer sonnet" on a Done item; the Sonnet reviewer spawn was real (#1774 round 2, record https://github.com/shivinate7/claude-settings/pull/1774#issuecomment-6720932212) but came before compaction. Decided (coordinator, 05:33 and 05:49 CST Nov 8): #1705 covers it, since its whole-transcript read keeps spawns from before a compaction. Lane report-guard-role-default-model (session_013NEJKyh5DtXyHyFdAmQUUz) adds a pinning test, red on main and green on #1705, with Merge after: #1919. Done when #1705 and that test merge.
